request.project_task: Build a travel expense submission and approval workflow.
request.project_goal: Reduce manual checking of employee expense claims.
request.project_description: An employee submits receipts; a manager reviews policy exceptions and finance reimburses approved claims.

functional_requirements.text: An employee creates an expense claim with trip details.

atoms.text: An employee creates an expense claim with trip details.

functional_requirements.text: The employee attaches receipts to expense items.

atoms.text: The employee attaches receipts to expense items.

functional_requirements.text: The system flags items above policy limits.

atoms.text: The system flags items above policy limits.

functional_requirements.text: A manager approves or rejects the claim.

atoms.text: A manager approves or rejects the claim.

functional_requirements.text: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.

atoms.text: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.

non_functional_requirements.text: Receipt files must be encrypted at rest.
All approval decisions must be auditable.

actors.name: Employee
actors.description: A staff member who incurs travel expenses and submits claims for reimbursement.

actors.name: Manager
actors.description: A person responsible for reviewing and approving or rejecting expense claims.

actors.name: Finance Officer
actors.description: A person responsible for recording reimbursement of approved claims.

actors.name: System
actors.description: The automated travel claims system that enforces policy and stores data.

use_cases.name: Submit Travel Expense Claim
use_cases.goal: Employee creates and submits a travel expense claim with trip details and attached receipts.
use_cases.trigger: Employee decides to submit a travel expense claim.

preconditions.text: Employee is authenticated and authorized to create expense claims.

success_postconditions.text: Expense claim is created with trip details and attached receipts, and is submitted for review.

failure_postconditions.text: Expense claim is not submitted; employee is informed of the failure.

main_success_scenario.name: Employee submits a complete expense claim

steps.action: Employee initiates creation of a new expense claim.
steps.expected_result: System presents a blank expense claim form.

steps.action: Employee enters trip details (destination, dates, purpose).
steps.expected_result: Trip details are recorded in the claim.

steps.action: Employee adds expense items and attaches receipts to each item.
steps.expected_result: Receipts are attached to expense items and stored securely.

steps.action: System flags any expense items that exceed policy limits.
steps.expected_result: Items above policy limits are marked for manager review.
Claim is submitted and routed to the manager for approval.

steps.action: Employee attempts to attach a receipt but the upload fails.
steps.expected_result: System displays an error and prompts the employee to retry.

user_stories.capability: create an expense claim with trip details and attach receipts
user_stories.benefit: I can submit my travel expenses for reimbursement

system_stories.system_action: Flag expense items above policy limits
system_stories.responsibility: Enforce travel expense policy by identifying items that exceed configured limits.
Ensure receipt files are stored securely in compliance with NFR-001.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Submit Travel Expense Claim
Goal: Employee creates and submits a travel expense claim with trip details and attached receipts.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Employee decides to submit a travel expense claim.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Employee is authenticated and authorized to create expense claims.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Employee initiates creation of a new expense claim.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Employee enters trip details (destination, dates, purpose).
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] Employee adds expense items and attaches receipts to each item.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] System flags any expense items that exceed policy limits.
  5. [STEP-UC001-005] Employee submits the claim.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Receipt attachment fails
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003

use_cases.name: Review and Decide on Expense Claim
use_cases.goal: Manager reviews a submitted expense claim, including flagged policy exceptions, and approves or rejects it.
use_cases.trigger: A submitted expense claim is routed to the manager for approval.

preconditions.text: Manager is authenticated and authorized to approve expense claims.
An expense claim has been submitted and is pending review.

success_postconditions.text: Claim is approved or rejected, and the decision is recorded with an audit trail.

failure_postconditions.text: Decision is not recorded; manager is informed of the failure.

main_success_scenario.name: Manager approves a claim with no policy exceptions

steps.action: Manager opens the submitted expense claim.
steps.expected_result: System displays claim details, attached receipts, and any policy flags.

steps.action: Manager reviews the claim and confirms no policy exceptions.
steps.expected_result: Manager decides to approve the claim.
Claim is marked as approved and the decision is recorded with an audit trail.

steps.action: Manager reviews the claim and identifies issues.
steps.expected_result: Manager decides to reject the claim.

steps.action: Manager rejects the claim and provides a reason.
steps.expected_result: Claim is marked as rejected and the decision is recorded with an audit trail.

user_stories.capability: review and approve or reject expense claims
user_stories.benefit: I can ensure compliance with travel policy

system_stories.system_action: Record approval decisions with an audit trail
system_stories.responsibility: Maintain an immutable log of all approval and rejection decisions for auditability.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Review and Decide on Expense Claim
Goal: Manager reviews a submitted expense claim, including flagged policy exceptions, and approves or rejects it.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: A submitted expense claim is routed to the manager for approval.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Manager is authenticated and authorized to approve expense claims.
  - PRE-UC002-002: An expense claim has been submitted and is pending review.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Manager opens the submitted expense claim.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] Manager reviews the claim and confirms no policy exceptions.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] Manager approves the claim.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-ALT-001: Manager rejects a claim
Source FRs: FR-004

use_cases.name: Record Reimbursement for Approved Claim
use_cases.goal: Finance officer records reimbursement for an approved expense claim.
use_cases.trigger: An expense claim has been approved by the manager.

preconditions.text: Finance officer is authenticated and authorized to record reimbursements.
An expense claim has been approved.

success_postconditions.text: Reimbursement is recorded for the approved claim.

failure_postconditions.text: Reimbursement is not recorded; finance officer is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Finance officer opens the approved expense claim.
steps.expected_result: System displays the approved claim details.

steps.action: Finance officer records the reimbursement amount and payment details.
steps.expected_result: Reimbursement is recorded and the claim is marked as reimbursed.

user_stories.benefit: I can ensure employees are paid accurately

system_stories.responsibility: Store reimbursement information and update claim status.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Record Reimbursement for Approved Claim
Goal: Finance officer records reimbursement for an approved expense claim.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: An expense claim has been approved by the manager.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Finance officer is authenticated and authorized to record reimbursements.
  - PRE-UC003-002: An expense claim has been approved.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Finance officer opens the approved expense claim.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Finance officer records the reimbursement amount and payment details.
Source FRs: FR-005
